[Acknowledges in alien language]''|Obi-Wan Kenobi and the Boosodian|quoteend=0|}} A [[Boosodian]] '''vendor''' operated an outdoor [[clothing]] stand called [[Chiu Mo Threads]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|II|appearance of the [[Boosodian]] [[Merchant|vendor]]}} the stand was visited by the [[Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], whom he had been sent to rescue from [[Ambush on Alderaan|capture]]. Kenobi bought a small [[Color|green]] [[cape]] from the Boosodian, which the [[merchant]] acknowledged in an [[alien]] [[language]], and Organa then picked up a pair of [[glove]]s as well. Despite Kenobi's insistence that the extra item was unnecessary, Organa ignored him and slipped them on, forcing Kenobi to pay for them. The Boosodian received some [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] from Kenobi before the Jedi left. The Boosodian had [[Color|white]] [[eye]]s, gray skin, and wore dark clothing with a hood. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|This person would be amazing for shoplifters.''"
"''So, maybe, that's like the clothing store when they're getting the clothes. This is the store owner that keeps watching everybody.|Deborah Chow and a crew member discussing the Boosodian's head in the creature shop|''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]''}} The Boosodian vendor appeared in "[[Part II]]," the second episode of the live-action series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']], which aired on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} When director [[Deborah Chow]] visited the creature shop, she suggested that the Boosodian's head could belong to someone who would be amazing at stopping shoplifters. A crew member suggested that the character could own a store and would be able to watch everyone, which Chow agreed with. ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Vendeur Boosodien non-identifié |ka=უცნობი ბუსოდელი ვაჭარი }} [[Category:Boosodians]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Merchants]]
